messages:
ana: heads up — after yesterday's routing policy change p95 for /v1/generate in eu-west looks ~15% higher, but p99 barely moved. curious if this is sampling/merge or a real perf tail change :thinking:

mike: can you paste the dashboard slice? p95 vs p99 divergence usually means the bulk shifted, not a true tail regression.

ana: here's the widget screenshot url: https://redwood.internal/dash/12345 (screenshot) and the quick query i ran: `SELECT percentile(lat_ms, 50,95,99) FROM latency WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND region='eu-west' AND ts > now() - 24h GROUP BY 1h`

mike: hm — are we sure the dashboard is using the route-merged rollup mode? when routes are merged we reweight samples by route weight which can move p50/p95 while p99 (rare events) stays stable.

tao: adding context — the routing change pushed more small-payload requests into the new low-latency pool. those inflate the sample count for the merged endpoint, lowering p50 but can push p95 up if they change batching behavior. odd to see p95 up while p50 down though.

sarah: could be a sampling origin flip: console has 2 sources (edge vs serving). if the p95 widget switched to composite rollup that mixes origin=client and origin=server, we can get inconsistent percentiles. i saw a related bug where the merge used unweighted histograms.

mike: can you run the raw histogram check? quick snippet: ```sql
SELECT count, bucket_start, bucket_end FROM hist_rollup WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND region='eu-west' AND window='1h' AND ts > now()-6h ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 5;
```

ana: running, one sec.

deploy-bot: canary rollout completed for routing-policy/v2 -> eu-west at 2026-03-20T10:12:03Z :white_check_mark:

ana: results: buckets show a spike in the 30-60ms bucket and also a small bump in 500-700ms. count increased ~12% overall.

mike: OK that pattern explains it — more mid-latency requests (30-60ms) push p95 upward if previous distribution was tighter. p99 unchanged because the true long tails didn't change.

tao: root cause is probably prefix-caching + continuous batching interplay on the new pool. smaller requests get better cache hits but also enable slightly larger batch sizes which add latency variance.

sarah: proposal for console UX: show sample origin and sample_count next to each percentile (p50/p95/p99) and a small sparkline of sample_count, so users can see distribution shifts vs sample volume. also add a tooltip: "merge mode = composite (weighted by route)."

mike: agree. also suggestion: surface the histogram peek (top 3 buckets) on hover so it's quick to diagnose without running SQL.

ana: will file a tiny frontend follow-up. @sarah @tao can we add a short note in the rollout playbook to check histogram spikes after routing changes?

tao: yeah i'll add it. also i'll put a guard in the rollout job that compares p95 pre/post and warns if >10% diff unless p99 also moved. simple early warning.

sarah: nice. add an escape hatch that only warns if sample_count > 1000 to avoid noise.

mike: :thumbsup: thanks all. ana — if you want i can pair on the dashboard mock for sample_count placement tomorrow.

ana: thanks, i'll take you up on that. tagging this resolved for now but keeping an eye on eu-west metrics. :eyes:
